text:
alice: Heads-up — planning a staggered traffic swap for frontend v2026.03 to reduce p95 spikes. Quiet window 23:00-23:30 UTC, small steps: 5->20->50 over ~10m intervals.
ben: 👍 what's the rollback plan if p95 jumps?
mira: We'll pin v2026.02 as fallback and keep warm instances for 10m after each step. If error rate >0.5% or p95 > 2200ms for 2 consecutive probes we tilt back to pinned.
ben: Sounds good. Who's onwatch?
sre-rota: I'm onwatch for that window. I'll monitor dashboards and run the routing commands if needed.
deploy-bot: deploy started: deploy frontend v2026.03 -> staging -> canary. Build: bld-2026.03-7f3a. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/12/build/7f3a
alice: Canary health OK, starting 5% weight shift to canary now. Running router change via safe-orch.
```sh
routerctl set-weight --service=frontend --variant=canary --weight=5 
routerctl status --service=frontend
```
mira: Metrics look stable at 5% for 5m. p95 down to 760ms, errors flat. Proceed to 20%.
alice: Applying 20%
deploy-bot: routing update queued by alice: frontend canary -> 20% (req id 4752)
sre-rota: Observability note — heatmap shows slight tail at 95th for a subset of regions (eu-west). I'll scope.
ben: If eu-west p95 > 1800ms we abort and shift back to pinned. Agree?
mira: Agree. Also prepping release notes snippet for support: "frontend v2026.03: query pipeline refactor; improved batching & cache TTL adjustments; expect lower median latency; monitor p95 in EU."
alice: 20% holding 8m, eu-west up to 950ms only. Continue to 50% in 5m unless we see regression.
sre-rota: If we need immediate rollback run:
```sh
routerctl set-weight --service=frontend --variant=stable --weight=100 --force
# then drain canary with: routerctl drain --service=frontend --variant=canary --timeout=300s
```
ben: Put manual hold if we hit either threshold. I'll be ready to trigger.
alice: Rolling to 50% now. Post-checks in 3m.
mira: At 50% — overall p95 = 820ms, eu-west = 1120ms (within threshold). No errors spike.
sre-rota: I'll keep heatmaps open and follow-up with post-rollout notes. :thumbsup:
alice: OK final step tomorrow morning non-quiet-window will finish the cutover to 100% with increased monitoring. Leaving pinned stable version and canary tags for quick revert. Thanks team.
